entries.title: Numbers 13:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 13:2
segments: "Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from each tribe of their fathers you shall send a man, every one a leader among them."

entries.title: Numbers 13:3
segments: So Moses sent them from the Wilderness of Paran according to the command of the LORD, all of them men who [were] heads of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 13:4
segments: Now these [were] their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur;

entries.title: Numbers 13:5
segments: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori;

entries.title: Numbers 13:6
segments: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh;

entries.title: Numbers 13:7
segments: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph;

entries.title: Numbers 13:8
segments: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun;

entries.title: Numbers 13:9
segments: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu;

entries.title: Numbers 13:10
segments: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi;

entries.title: Numbers 13:11
segments: from the tribe of Joseph, [that is], from the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi;

entries.title: Numbers 13:12
segments: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli;

entries.title: Numbers 13:13
segments: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael;

entries.title: Numbers 13:14
segments: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi;

entries.title: Numbers 13:15
segments: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:16
segments: These [are] the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun, Joshua.

entries.title: Numbers 13:17
segments: Then Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, "Go up this [way] into the South, and go up to the mountains,

entries.title: Numbers 13:18
segments: "and see what the land is like: whether the people who dwell in it [are] strong or weak, few or many;

entries.title: Numbers 13:19
segments: "whether the land they dwell in [is] good or bad; whether the cities they inhabit [are] like camps or strongholds;

entries.title: Numbers 13:20
segments: "whether the land [is] rich or poor; and whether there are forests there or not. Be of good courage. And bring some of the fruit of the land." Now the time [was] the season of the first ripe grapes.

entries.title: Numbers 13:21
segments: ¶So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, near the entrance of Hamath.

entries.title: Numbers 13:22
segments: And they went up through the South and came to Hebron; Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, [were] there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

entries.title: Numbers 13:23
segments: Then they came to the Valley of Eshcol, and there cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes; they carried it between two of them on a pole. [They] also [brought] some of the pomegranates and figs.

entries.title: Numbers 13:24
segments: The place was called the Valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the men of Israel cut down there.

entries.title: Numbers 13:25
segments: And they returned from spying out the land after forty days.

entries.title: Numbers 13:26
segments: ¶Now they departed and came back to Moses and Aaron and all the congregation of the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

entries.title: Numbers 13:27
segments: Then they told him, and said: "We went to the land where you sent us. It truly flows with milk and honey, and this [is] its fruit.

entries.title: Numbers 13:28
segments: "Nevertheless the people who dwell in the land [are] strong; the cities [are] fortified [and] very large; moreover we saw the descendants of Anak there.

entries.title: Numbers 13:29
segments: "The Amalekites dwell in the land of the South; the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the mountains; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea and along the banks of the Jordan."

entries.title: Numbers 13:30
segments: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses, and said, "Let us go up at once and take possession, for we are well able to overcome it."

entries.title: Numbers 13:31
segments: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not able to go up against the people, for they [are] stronger than we."

entries.title: Numbers 13:32
segments: And they gave the children of Israel a bad report of the land which they had spied out, saying, "The land through which we have gone as spies [is] a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in it [are] men of [great] stature.

entries.title: Numbers 13:33
segments: "There we saw the giants (the descendants of Anak came from the giants); and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight."
